why: Files under src that still turn a number into text somewhere other than canonicalNumber in src/core/emit/canonical.ts, each with the number of conversions found when it was recorded and the reason it is tolerated. scripts/check-number-writer.mjs fails the build on a file with more conversions than its row records, on one with fewer, because a row left at an old count is room for a conversion to come back, and on a row whose file converts nothing outside the writer any more. The list only shrinks: a row is retired by routing its conversions through the writer, and a file with no row may not convert at all.
